summary_1line: Hanuman launches his immense leap across the ocean toward Lanka, overcoming tests from Mainaka, Surasa, and the demoness Simhika.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman expands to gigantic size on the mountain peak and launches into the sky, uprooting trees that whirl behind him as he leaps over the ocean.
The golden mountain Mainaka rises from the sea with shining peaks to offer Hanuman a resting place amid the waves.
Hanuman shrinks to thumb-size, darts into Surasa’s enormous open mouth, and instantly flies back out into the sky before she can close it.
